mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q01.stem: General thickness ranges sa comparison table. Angkop na use?
options: Method-comparison guide; hiwalay check product specs/conditions
reasons: Hindi individual-product criterion ang general range.
Hindi thickness lamang ang best performance.
Ihiwalay ang comparison guide sa requirements/conditions.
Mahalaga ang base sa method selection.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q02.stem: Material changed ngunit old-material pa ang process sheet. Angkop?
options: Inquiry sa pretreatment, underlayer, inspection; markahan at hold
Thicker main film, kaya walang check
reasons: Hindi new-material guarantee ang old success.
Hold at identify hanggang base-change impact checks.
Hindi compatibility o pretreatment substitute ang thickening.
Huwag isulat ang material name na iba sa actual.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q03.stem: Angkop sa hot-dip interfacial alloy layer?
options: Tiyakin ang base/bath/conditions at required dimensions
reasons: Ayon sa combinations at process ang layer.
May relation ang layer/thickness sa fit dimensions.
Hindi same kapag iba ang material/treatment.
Sabay tiyakin ang base, bath, conditions, at dimensions.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q04.stem: Hole hanggang base at depression hindi hanggang base. Angkop?
options: Pinhole ang una, pit ang huli; specified inspection
Lahat blister kahit walang depth check
reasons: Ihiwalay ang holes/depressions at gamitin ang procedure.
Separation ang blister, hindi lahat ng holes.
Hindi shallow lamang ang product pass-fail.
Binabago ang state sa unauthorized widening.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q05.stem: Malakas na mirror gloss sa hairline product. Angkop?
options: Itugma ang sample, direction, conditions; humingi ng judgment
reasons: Hindi laging mirror ang requirement.
Kasama ang direction sa hairline requirements.
Humingi ng judgment batay sa sample, direction, at inspection.
Huwag burahin ang requirement sa unauthorized renaming.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q06.stem: Repeated edge peeling matapos polish. Angkop?
options: Itala ang position, holding, angle; ipadala sa specified evaluation
reasons: Hindi cause/compliance check ang pagtatago.
Maaaring ibang heat defects ang speed increase.
Ihiwalay ang suspect nonconforming.
Itala ang positions at conditions para sa approved evaluation.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q07.stem: Nondestructive thickness meter. Angkop na understanding?
options: Less sample damage ngunit kailangan ang compatibility/safety
reasons: Hiwalay ang sample damage at safety/compatibility controls.
Maaaring may dedicated X-ray management.
May principle-specific base, film, shape scope.
Kailangan ang calibration at references.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q08.stem: Angkop sa metal film sa resin?
options: May methods na kailangan ang compatibility/pretreatment
reasons: May metal-coating methods sa nonmetal.
Tiyakin ang material, pretreatment, catalyst compatibility.
Kailangan ang resin type at process conditions.
Hindi malalaktawan ang needed pretreatment sa nonconductive base.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q09.stem: Treatment sheet zinc system naging aluminum system. Angkop?
options: Itugma ang material, number, performance, dimensions
reasons: Ibang bath material, ibang conditions.
Hindi color ang compatibility proof.
Huwag unconditionally old temp.
Itugma ang specified material, process number, performance, dimensions.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q10.stem: May excess hot-dip-metal projection sa edge. Angkop?
options: Itala location/dimensions, markahan, at humingi ng requirement-based decision
Small textbook impact, kaya iwan lahat
reasons: Itala ang sag position, dimensions, history at judge sa specs.
Hindi general explanation ang lahat-product leave decision.
Nagbabago ang dimensions/film kaya approval.
Hindi single-cause proof ang appearance.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q11.stem: Tama sa grit number at roughness?
options: Same grit sa lahat product systems
Grit ay fineness guide; iba sa measured roughness
Same grit, same result lahat materials
reasons: Magkaibang quantities.
Huwag unconditional equivalence ng systems.
Particle-fineness guide ang grit, iba sa actual roughness.
Material at state din ang result.

mfg1-surface-weekly-09-q12.stem: Dagdag na information sa thickness mula coating-removal mass difference?
reasons: Hindi color ang mass-thickness conversion.
Area, density, at removal compatibility ang prerequisites.
Hindi preference ang basis.
Hindi needed physical quantity ang weekday.
